stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist receives several prescriptions for testosterone cypionate. Which scenarios fit the current statutory pharmacist-administration category specifically because of the indication? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A veterinarian's testosterone order for an animal, relying on the human gender-affirming administration provision
A prescribed dose for gender-affirming care
A subsequent prescribed gender-affirming dose after the pharmacist verifies the same authorized pathway remains satisfied
A prescribed dose for routine testosterone-replacement therapy for hypogonadism, relying only on the gender-affirming statute
A bodybuilding request with no valid prescription

explanation.core_reasoning: For this pharmacist-administration authority, gender-affirming indication is legally material even though the testosterone product is unchanged.

choice_analysis.A: The cited human pharmacist-administration category does not fit.
choice_analysis.C: The category is indication-based, not limited to a single first dose.
choice_analysis.E: Neither indication nor prescription authority is satisfied.

related_facts: Testosterone remains federally Schedule III regardless of this administration category.
explanation.mpje_trap: Letting one authorized use of a drug create blanket administration authority for all uses.

reasoning_steps: Classify the indication for each scenario
